title: Warm Velvety Australian Jerusalem Artichoke Gratin
description: This fermented and velvety Australian dish features Jerusalem artichokes, tempering chocolate, and is ayurvedic-rajasic-friendly, making it perfect for a festive occasion.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large saucepan, combine the sliced Jerusalem artichokes and enough cold water to cover them, then bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 10 minutes, or until the artichokes are slightly tender.
Drain the artichokes and set them aside to cool.
In a large skillet, melt the butter over medium heat, then add the chopped tempering chocolate and cook, stirring constantly, until melted and smooth.
In a large bowl, combine the cooked artichokes, melted chocolate mixture, heavy cream, shredded gruyere cheese, salt, black pepper, and chopped fresh thyme, and stir until well combined.
Transfer the artichoke mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and smooth the top.
Bake for 25 minutes, or until the top is golden brown and the gratin is heated through.
Remove the gratin from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the gratin warm, garnished with additional chopped fresh thyme if desired.
